## 🎯 Pattern Selection & Decision Trees

### 1. Arbre de Décision Complet

Choisir le bon pattern selon le contexte de ta tâche.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-pattern-decision-tree
%%| fig-cap: "Arbre de décision pour choisir le pattern d'exécution"
%%| fig-width: 12
flowchart TD
    Start([Nouvelle Tâche<br/>à Orchestrer]) --> Understand[Analyser la Tâche]

    Understand --> Independent{Les tâches sont-elles<br/>INDÉPENDANTES?}

    Independent -->|✅ Oui| CheckScale{Combien<br/>d'items?}
    Independent -->|❌ Non| CheckDeps{Type de<br/>dépendances?}

    CheckScale -->|2-10 items| SmallParallel[Small Parallel<br/>Single Wave]
    CheckScale -->|11-50 items| MediumBatch[Medium Batch<br/>Waves of 10]
    CheckScale -->|51-200 items| LargeBatch[Large Batch<br/>Waves of 20]
    CheckScale -->|200+ items| XLBatch[XL Batch<br/>Progressive waves]

    CheckDeps -->|Strictes<br/>Séquentielles| Sequential[Sequential Pattern]
    CheckDeps -->|Conditionnelles| Dynamic{Logique<br/>Dynamique?}
    CheckDeps -->|Hybrides| Hybrid[Hybrid Pattern]

    Dynamic -->|Oui| Conditional[Conditional Pattern]
    Dynamic -->|Non| Sequential

    SmallParallel --> Metrics1[Speedup: 5-10x<br/>Cost: Medium<br/>Complexity: Low]
    MediumBatch --> Metrics2[Speedup: 10-15x<br/>Cost: Medium<br/>Complexity: Medium]
    LargeBatch --> Metrics3[Speedup: 15-20x<br/>Cost: High<br/>Complexity: High]
    XLBatch --> Metrics4[Speedup: 20-50x<br/>Cost: Very High<br/>Complexity: Very High]

    Sequential --> Metrics5[Speedup: 1x<br/>Cost: Low<br/>Quality: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐]
    Conditional --> Metrics6[Speedup: Variable<br/>Cost: Variable<br/>Flexibility: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐]
    Hybrid --> Metrics7[Speedup: 10-30x<br/>Cost: High<br/>Power: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐]

    classDef pattern fill:#2196F3,stroke:#1565C0,color:#fff,font-weight:bold
    classDef decision fill:#FF9800,stroke:#E65100,color:#fff
    classDef metrics fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff

    class SmallParallel,MediumBatch,LargeBatch,XLBatch,Sequential,Conditional,Hybrid pattern
    class Independent,CheckScale,CheckDeps,Dynamic decision
    class Metrics1,Metrics2,Metrics3,Metrics4,Metrics5,Metrics6,Metrics7 metrics
```

## ⛓️ Sequential Execution Pattern

### 8. CI/CD State Machine

Machine à états complète pour un pipeline CI/CD.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-cicd-state-machine
%%| fig-cap: "State Machine CI/CD Pipeline"
%%| fig-height: 10
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle : Pipeline Ready

    Idle --> Build : Trigger Deploy

    Build --> Building : Start Build
    Building --> BuildSuccess : ✅ Artifacts OK
    Building --> BuildFailed : ❌ Compilation Error

    BuildSuccess --> Test : Proceed to Tests
    BuildFailed --> Rollback : Revert Changes

    Test --> Testing : Run Test Suite
    Testing --> TestSuccess : ✅ All Pass (>80%)
    Testing --> TestPartial : ⚠️ Some Pass (60-80%)
    Testing --> TestFailed : ❌ Many Fail (<60%)

    TestSuccess --> Deploy : Proceed to Deploy
    TestPartial --> ManualReview : Require Approval
    TestFailed --> Rollback

    ManualReview --> Deploy : ✅ Approved
    ManualReview --> Rollback : ❌ Rejected

    Deploy --> Deploying : Deploy to Prod
    Deploying --> HealthCheck : Monitor Health

    HealthCheck --> DeploySuccess : ✅ Healthy (5min)
    HealthCheck --> DeployDegraded : ⚠️ Warnings
    HealthCheck --> DeployFailed : ❌ Critical Errors

    DeploySuccess --> [*] : Pipeline Complete
    DeployDegraded --> ManualDecision : Escalate
    DeployFailed --> AutoRollback : Automatic Rollback

    ManualDecision --> [*] : Accept Warnings
    ManualDecision --> AutoRollback : Force Rollback

    AutoRollback --> Rollback
    Rollback --> [*] : Pipeline Aborted

    note right of BuildFailed
        Quality Gate 1:
        Build must succeed
    end note

    note right of TestFailed
        Quality Gate 2:
        Coverage > 80%
    end note

    note right of DeployFailed
        Quality Gate 3:
        Health checks pass
    end note
```

### 9. Sequential Execution Flow

Flow détaillé des phases séquentielles.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-sequential-flow
%%| fig-cap: "Sequential Execution Flow"
flowchart TD
    Start([Command Triggered]) --> Phase1Init[Phase 1: BUILD<br/>Initialize]

    Phase1Init --> BuildAgent[🔨 Builder Agent<br/>Compile Code]
    BuildAgent --> BuildCheck{Build<br/>Success?}

    BuildCheck -->|✅ Yes| BuildMetrics[📊 Log Metrics<br/>Time: 8min<br/>Artifacts: 45MB]
    BuildCheck -->|❌ No| BuildError[❌ Report Error<br/>Compilation failed at line 342]

    BuildError --> Abort1[⛔ ABORT Pipeline]

    BuildMetrics --> Phase2Init[Phase 2: TEST<br/>Initialize]

    Phase2Init --> TestAgent[🧪 Tester Agent<br/>Run Test Suite]
    TestAgent --> TestCheck{Coverage<br/>>80%?}

    TestCheck -->|✅ Yes| TestMetrics[📊 Log Metrics<br/>Coverage: 87%<br/>Tests: 342/342 pass]
    TestCheck -->|❌ No| TestError[❌ Report Error<br/>Coverage only 65%]

    TestError --> Abort2[⛔ ABORT Pipeline]

    TestMetrics --> Phase3Init[Phase 3: DEPLOY<br/>Initialize]

    Phase3Init --> DeployAgent[🚀 Deployer Agent<br/>Deploy to Prod]
    DeployAgent --> DeployCheck{Health<br/>Checks?}

    DeployCheck -->|✅ Yes| DeployMetrics[📊 Log Metrics<br/>Uptime: 100%<br/>Latency: 45ms]
    DeployCheck -->|❌ No| DeployError[❌ Report Error<br/>Service timeout]

    DeployError --> Abort3[⛔ ABORT + ROLLBACK]

    DeployMetrics --> Success[✅ Pipeline Complete<br/>Total: 25min<br/>Quality: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐]

    Abort1 --> End([End])
    Abort2 --> End
    Abort3 --> End
    Success --> End

    classDef phase fill:#2196F3,stroke:#1565C0,color:#fff
    classDef agent fill:#FF9800,stroke:#E65100,color:#fff
    classDef success fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff
    classDef error fill:#F44336,stroke:#C62828,color:#fff

    class Phase1Init,Phase2Init,Phase3Init phase
    class BuildAgent,TestAgent,DeployAgent agent
    class BuildMetrics,TestMetrics,DeployMetrics,Success success
    class BuildError,TestError,DeployError,Abort1,Abort2,Abort3 error
```

```{mermaid}
    Deploy to Production (3min):deploy2, after smoke, 3m
    Health Check (5min)        :health, after deploy2, 5m
    Quality Gate: Health OK    :milestone, qg3, after health, 0m
    Log Deploy Metrics         :metrics3, after qg3, 30s

    section Reporting
    Generate Report            :report, after metrics3, 1m
    Pipeline Complete          :milestone, done, after report, 0m
```

## 📦 Batch Processing Pattern

### 11. Batch Wave Execution

Architecture des vagues de traitement.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-batch-waves
%%| fig-cap: "Batch Processing avec Waves"
%%| fig-width: 12
graph TB
    Start([Dataset: 500 Items]) --> Planner[Batch Planner<br/>Calculate waves]

    Planner --> Config[Config:<br/>• Wave size: 20<br/>• Waves total: 25<br/>• Error threshold: 5%]

    Config --> Wave1[Wave 1: Items 1-20]

    subgraph W1[Wave 1 Execution]
        direction LR
        W1_A1[Agent 1] & W1_A2[Agent 2] & W1_A3[Agent 3] & W1_A20[... Agent 20]
    end

    Wave1 --> W1

    W1 --> W1_Results[(Results 1-20)]
    W1_Results --> W1_Check{Errors?}

    W1_Check -->|0 errors| Wave2[Wave 2: Items 21-40]
    W1_Check -->|1-3 errors| W1_Retry[Retry Failed Items]
    W1_Check -->|4+ errors| W1_Abort[⛔ ABORT: High Error Rate]

    W1_Retry --> Wave2

    subgraph W2[Wave 2 Execution]
        direction LR
        W2_A1[Agent 21] & W2_A2[Agent 22] & W2_A3[Agent 23] & W2_A20[... Agent 40]
    end

    Wave2 --> W2

    W2 --> W2_Results[(Results 21-40)]
    W2_Results --> W2_Check{Errors?}

    W2_Check -->|OK| Wave3[Wave 3: Items 41-60]
    W2_Check -->|Retry| W2_Retry[Retry Failed]

    W2_Retry --> Wave3

    Wave3 --> WaveDots[... 22 more waves ...]

    WaveDots --> Wave25[Wave 25: Items 481-500]

    subgraph W25[Wave 25 Execution]
        direction LR
        W25_A1[Agent 481] & W25_A2[Agent 482] & W25_A20[... Agent 500]
    end

    Wave25 --> W25

    W25 --> W25_Results[(Results 481-500)]
    W25_Results --> Final[Final Aggregation]

    Final --> Report[📊 Report:<br/>✅ 487/500 success (97.4%)<br/>⚠️ 13 warnings<br/>❌ 0 failures<br/>⏱️ 12.5 hours]

    W1_Abort --> End([End with Error])
    Report --> End2([End Success])

    classDef wave fill:#9C27B0,stroke:#6A1B9A,color:#fff
    classDef agent fill:#FF9800,stroke:#E65100,color:#fff
    classDef result fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff
    classDef error fill:#F44336,stroke:#C62828,color:#fff

    class Wave1,Wave2,Wave3,Wave25 wave
    class W1_A1,W1_A2,W1_A3,W1_A20,W2_A1,W2_A2,W2_A3,W2_A20,W25_A1,W25_A2,W25_A20 agent
    class W1_Results,W2_Results,W25_Results,Report result
    class W1_Abort error
```

### 12. Batch Error Handling

Stratégie de gestion d'erreurs par batch.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-batch-error-handling
%%| fig-cap: "Batch Error Handling Strategy"
flowchart TD
    Wave([Wave N Completed]) --> Collect[Collect Results]

    Collect --> Count{Count<br/>Errors}

    Count -->|0 errors| NextWave[✅ Proceed to Wave N+1]
    Count -->|1-5 errors| Analyze[Analyze Error Types]
    Count -->|6-10 errors| Warning[⚠️ Warning Threshold]
    Count -->|11+ errors| Critical[🔴 Critical Threshold]

    Analyze --> ErrorTypes{Error<br/>Type?}

    ErrorTypes -->|Timeout| Retry1[Retry with +30s timeout]
    ErrorTypes -->|API Rate Limit| Wait[Wait 60s then retry]
    ErrorTypes -->|Data Error| Skip[Skip + Log for manual review]
    ErrorTypes -->|Unknown| Escalate[Escalate to user]

    Retry1 --> RetryCheck{Retry<br/>Success?}
    Wait --> RetryCheck

    RetryCheck -->|✅ Yes| NextWave
    RetryCheck -->|❌ No| Skip

    Skip --> NextWave
    Escalate --> UserDecision{User<br/>Decision?}

    UserDecision -->|Continue| NextWave
    UserDecision -->|Abort| Abort[⛔ ABORT All Waves]

    Warning --> ReviewErrors[Review Error Patterns]
    ReviewErrors --> WarningDecision{Continue?}

    WarningDecision -->|Yes| NextWave
    WarningDecision -->|No| Abort

    Critical --> Abort

    NextWave --> End([Continue Processing])
    Abort --> End2([Pipeline Stopped])

    classDef success fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff
    classDef warning fill:#FF9800,stroke:#E65100,color:#fff
    classDef error fill:#F44336,stroke:#C62828,color:#fff

    class NextWave,Retry1,RetryCheck success
    class Warning,WarningDecision,Analyze warning
    class Critical,Abort,Abort error
```

## 🔄 Conditional Execution Pattern

### 14. Content Type Router

Routing complexe basé sur le type de contenu.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-content-router
%%| fig-cap: "Conditional Content Router"
%%| fig-width: 12
flowchart TD
    Input([User Input]) --> Detect[Detect Content Type]

    Detect --> Type{Content<br/>Type?}

    Type -->|Image| ImageFlow[Image Processing Flow]
    Type -->|Video| VideoFlow[Video Processing Flow]
    Type -->|Text| TextFlow[Text Processing Flow]
    Type -->|Audio| AudioFlow[Audio Processing Flow]
    Type -->|Code| CodeFlow[Code Processing Flow]
    Type -->|Unknown| Fallback[Fallback Handler]

    ImageFlow --> ImgFormat{Format?}
    ImgFormat -->|PNG/JPG| ImgQuality{Quality?}
    ImgFormat -->|SVG| VectorAgent[Vector Processor]
    ImgFormat -->|GIF| AnimAgent[Animation Processor]

    ImgQuality -->|High| OCRAgent[OCR + Analysis]
    ImgQuality -->|Low| EnhanceAgent[Enhance + OCR]

    VideoFlow --> VidDuration{Duration?}
    VidDuration -->|<1min| ShortAgent[Short Video Processor]
    VidDuration -->|1-10min| MediumAgent[Medium Video + Transcription]
    VidDuration -->|>10min| LongAgent[Long Video + Chapters]

    TextFlow --> Lang{Language?}
    Lang -->|English| NLPAgent[Direct NLP Analysis]
    Lang -->|Other| TranslateAgent[Translate + NLP]

    AudioFlow --> AudioDuration{Duration?}
    AudioDuration -->|<5min| QuickTranscribe[Quick Transcription]
    AudioDuration -->|>5min| FullTranscribe[Full Transcription + Diarization]

    CodeFlow --> CodeLang{Language?}
    CodeLang -->|Python/JS/TS| LintAgent[Lint + Security Scan]
    CodeLang -->|Other| GenericAgent[Generic Code Analysis]

    Fallback --> UserInput[Ask User for Type]

    OCRAgent & EnhanceAgent & VectorAgent & AnimAgent --> Output
    ShortAgent & MediumAgent & LongAgent --> Output
    NLPAgent & TranslateAgent --> Output
    QuickTranscribe & FullTranscribe --> Output
    LintAgent & GenericAgent --> Output
    UserInput --> Output

    Output[Aggregated Output]

    classDef input fill:#9C27B0,stroke:#6A1B9A,color:#fff
    classDef decision fill:#FF9800,stroke:#E65100,color:#fff
    classDef agent fill:#2196F3,stroke:#1565C0,color:#fff
    classDef output fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff

    class Input,UserInput input
    class Type,ImgFormat,ImgQuality,VidDuration,Lang,AudioDuration,CodeLang decision
    class OCRAgent,EnhanceAgent,VectorAgent,AnimAgent,ShortAgent,MediumAgent,LongAgent,NLPAgent,TranslateAgent,QuickTranscribe,FullTranscribe,LintAgent,GenericAgent agent
    class Output output
```

### 15. Conditional State Transitions

Machine à états pour routing conditionnel.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-conditional-states
%%| fig-cap: "Conditional Pattern State Machine"
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Receive : Input Received

    Receive --> Analyze : Analyze Properties

    Analyze --> RouteDecision : Evaluate Conditions

    RouteDecision --> PathA : Priority = High
    RouteDecision --> PathB : Priority = Medium
    RouteDecision --> PathC : Priority = Low
    RouteDecision --> PathDefault : No Match

    PathA --> ExecuteA : Launch Agent A<br/>(Escalation Handler)
    PathB --> ExecuteB : Launch Agent B<br/>(Standard Processor)
    PathC --> ExecuteC : Launch Agent C<br/>(Batch Queue)
    PathDefault --> ExecuteDefault : Launch Fallback

    ExecuteA --> SuccessA : ✅ High Priority Handled
    ExecuteB --> SuccessB : ✅ Medium Priority Handled
    ExecuteC --> SuccessC : ✅ Low Priority Queued
    ExecuteDefault --> SuccessDefault : ✅ Fallback Completed

    SuccessA --> [*] : Return Result
    SuccessB --> [*] : Return Result
    SuccessC --> [*] : Return Result
    SuccessDefault --> [*] : Return Result

    note right of PathA
        High Priority:
        - Errors
        - Urgent requests
        - VIP users
    end note

    note right of PathB
        Medium Priority:
        - Regular requests
        - Standard users
    end note

    note right of PathC
        Low Priority:
        - Batch jobs
        - Non-urgent tasks
    end note
```

### 20. Class Diagram - Pattern Architecture

Architecture orientée objet des patterns.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-class-diagram
%%| fig-cap: "Class Diagram - Pattern Architecture"
classDiagram
    class Orchestrator {
        +String name
        +Pattern pattern
        +execute()
        +aggregate()
        +report()
    }

    class Pattern {
        <<interface>>
        +String type
        +execute()
    }

    class ParallelPattern {
        +Int waveSize
        +executeParallel()
        +aggregateResults()
    }

    class SequentialPattern {
        +List~Phase~ phases
        +executeSequential()
        +validatePhase()
    }

    class BatchPattern {
        +Int batchSize
        +Int totalWaves
        +executeBatch()
        +handleErrors()
    }

    class ConditionalPattern {
        +Map~Condition, Agent~ routes
        +evaluateConditions()
        +routeToAgent()
    }

    class Agent {
        +String id
        +String type
        +execute()
        +report()
    }

    class Task {
        +String description
        +String status
        +Result result
    }

    class Result {
        +Boolean success
        +String data
        +List~Error~ errors
    }

    Orchestrator --> Pattern : uses
    Pattern <|-- ParallelPattern : implements
    Pattern <|-- SequentialPattern : implements
    Pattern <|-- BatchPattern : implements
    Pattern <|-- ConditionalPattern : implements

    Orchestrator --> Agent : manages
    Agent --> Task : executes
    Task --> Result : produces

    ParallelPattern --> Agent : spawns multiple
    SequentialPattern --> Agent : spawns one at a time
    BatchPattern --> Agent : spawns in waves
    ConditionalPattern --> Agent : routes conditionally
```
